INTB 1209 applicability conflict (reviewed 2026-10-11): the official International Business concentration table lists INTB 1209 as an alternative to INTB 1203, but the subject catalog says INTB 1209 does not count for business majors and its INTB 1203 equivalence is only for business minors. Both sources are preserved; institutional clarification is needed before treating this alternative as eligible for the combined Business degree.
